card.name: Later digits inside decimal numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token that comes after a decimal point or after earlier digits in a number, such as the 6 in 99.6 or the 5 in 0.15. It appears in dose ranges, tables and statistics.

modes.label: Final digit of a decimal
modes.description: The last digit of a decimal value in a dose range or a percentage.
modes.example: Psychotic Disorders - 0.05 mg/kg/day to 0.1<<5>> mg/kg/day Nonpsychotic Behavior Disorders

modes.label: Digit in a number table
modes.description: A digit ending a value in a row of table numbers.
